brief.title: IPL 2026 Ball-by-Ball Analytics Report
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive ball-by-ball analysis of the IPL 2026 season covering batting, bowling, extras, and dismissal patterns across all matches.
brief.goal: Provide cricket analysts and team strategists with granular insights into scoring patterns, bowler effectiveness, dismissal trends, and team performance dynamics derived from delivery-level data to inform tactical decisions and fantasy cricket predictions.

required_sections.title: Tournament Overview & Match Summary
required_sections.objective: Summarize the number of matches played, venues used, teams involved, total deliveries bowled, and overall run-scoring and wicket-taking aggregates across the tournament.

required_sections.title: Batting Performance Analysis
required_sections.objective: Identify top run-scorers by aggregating runs_of_bat per striker, analyze boundary frequency (4s and 6s), strike rates, and scoring patterns across overs (powerplay, middle overs, death overs).

required_sections.title: Bowling Performance Analysis
required_sections.objective: Rank bowlers by wickets taken, economy rate, and dot-ball percentage. Analyze dismissal types and identify the most effective bowlers in different match phases.

required_sections.title: Team Performance Comparison
required_sections.objective: Compare batting and bowling team performances including average runs per innings, extras conceded, wickets lost, and net scoring rates to highlight the strongest and weakest teams.

required_sections.title: Extras & Bowling Discipline
required_sections.objective: Analyze the distribution of extras (wides, no-balls, byes, leg-byes) by team and bowler to assess bowling discipline and its impact on match outcomes.

required_sections.title: Venue & Match Phase Insights
required_sections.objective: Examine scoring trends by venue and by match phase (innings, over ranges) to identify high-scoring grounds and the impact of batting first vs. chasing.

kpis.name: Average Runs Per Over
kpis.description: Total runs scored (runs_of_bat + extras) divided by total overs bowled, indicating the overall scoring rate of the tournament.

kpis.name: Boundary Percentage
kpis.description: Percentage of deliveries that resulted in a four (runs_of_bat=4) or six (runs_of_bat=6) out of all deliveries faced.

kpis.name: Dot Ball Percentage
kpis.description: Percentage of deliveries where runs_of_bat=0 and extras=0, reflecting bowling pressure across the tournament.

kpis.name: Extras Per Match
kpis.description: Average total extras (wides, no-balls, byes, leg-byes) conceded per match, indicating overall bowling discipline.

kpis.name: Wickets Per Match
kpis.description: Average number of wickets falling per match, reflecting the balance between bat and ball.
